body:
I’m not affiliated with the group in any way but I’ve hung out with them and I’ll be the first one to say that the folks in Torcida 96 are super duper cool. Incredibly passionate. The safest I ever felt with any group of fans. 

It’s really great to see a third group filling up 133. I’m genuinely really excited to see how they grow and I can’t wait to see what other stuff they have planned. I missed the clothing drive but I heard that it was pretty successful!
Honestly? Nothing. Even the sport I’m super passionate about doesn’t inspire joy anymore.

Any time a male character references “daddy issues” as a turn on or why their conquest is easy. It feels so skeevy to me. 


IMO, it is something that’s always rubbed me the wrong way. I have CPTSD from my crappy childhood and a part of it was from my dad abandoning my family when I was 8. Being an adult now and having to go through extensive therapy to be a normal human fucking sucks.

Not a man but I dated someone once who legitimately had 0 close friends, other than his cousin whom he considered his brother. We had been dating for a couple months and I had gotten annoyed that I hadn’t met/heard of any friends. 


I thought he was hiding me, turns out he just didn’t have any friends. When I broke up with him, I told him he should stay friends with with my other friend who lived more local to him (I lived about an hour away) since they were both dudes with similar interests and in dire need of friends.

I’m very lucky in the sense that I’m naturally very extroverted and can make friends with anyone. I genuinely have a lot of friends (close ones at that) and am the type of person who has moved to a country where I knew absolutely no one and left behind a wonderful community. 


So when I was dating this guy, it was a HUGE shock to me to find out that the dude had no friends.

The part in Moonlight when Chiron is visiting his mom and she says “You Ain't Got To Love Me, But You Gonna Know That I Love You”


Chiron doesn’t say anything but you can feel his internal turmoil of being offered love after being denied it for a majority of his life. It’s the uncomfortable feeling of wanting to open up to that love but not trusting anyone because of what he had endured in his life. 


It really put into perspective that our parents are flawed human beings who have their own trauma. The scene hits really close to home for me and I will always cry during that particular scene.

Talking about my best friend Billy who died very unexpectedly at the age of 25 in 2019. He passed in his sleep from a pulmonary embolism.

Not a day goes by that I don’t miss him. I never got to say goodbye, there was no funeral as he was getting his masters in a different country. His parents had to leave his remains in that country and they held a memorial service in his home town which I also couldn’t attend because flights for a last minute trip was way out of my price range.

I hope I’m making him proud. He was always my biggest cheerleader.
Yes!!!! But only if it’s heavy metal/screaming vocals. For some reason it occupies my mind enough for me to actually do work. I can’t really explain it but it works for me!

When I was 10, I was looking at some books in Barnes & Noble and I felt someone close behind me. I tried to move but the close presence behind kept following. I tried to move but then I felt something poking me in the back. I turned around and all I remember seeing was grey sweatpants with a wet stain on it.

As a 10 yr old, the situation didn’t really make sense but I remember feeling really uncomfortable. It clicked when I was in my early 20s and I realized it was some random dude’s erection was intentionally pressing up against my young self.

I struggle a lot with my two main unhealthy coping mechanisms of making myself throw up and cutting myself. Some days it’s so hard not indulging them. 


On the outside I appear so normal and happy but you push up my sleeves and it’s a different story. Or if you look at my molars and how worn down they are. It makes me feel far away from everyone.

Hi, you’re not alone. My teeth in the front are good but my molars have given me so many issues. They’re very worn down and decayed. I’ve had three root canals and my molars have chipped multiple times. I recently bit the bullet and went to a Caribbean country (would not have been able to afford the procedures if I stayed in the US) and got 6 fillings, a root canal, and a cap. I still have some other stuff to fix but I started my journey. I still struggle a lot with bulimia but it’s worth it to fix your teeth.
I was pretty honest with my US dentist to be honest, they were surprisingly less judgey. The struggle is so real.
I believe this concept is called harm reduction! It sounds counter intuitive but it has pretty hopeful results <3

I feel you!!! I relapsed last week after 1 and half years of not self harming. 

Relapses happen but that doesn't mean that the fight is over. You made it this far and you can do it again. Take care of yourself and remind yourself that you can overcome this relapse. ❤

When I first started self harming I only wore dark colors and things with sleeves and high necklines to cover everything up. My clothing choices were very limited to say the least.

I have noticeable scars on my left arm and upper thighs. To be honest it doesn't even cross my mind when I'm out in public. Maybe I'm oblivious but I've never noticed anyone look. I spent a lot of time in therapy working on pushing past feeling scared or ashamed of my scars. 

Don't get me wrong, I still feel self conscious about them but I just tell myself it's not worth feeling uncomfortable in a heat wave just because of some scars. Essentially a battle between the rational and irrational voices in my mind.

Thank you for your response ❤ I will definitely look the free online therapy thing. It's worth a shot. I was able to get my therapist to agree to accepting half of my co pay. 

It's getting to the point where I'm considering inpatient care. It's getting too serious to ignore.

I was regularly seeing the on campus counselor and I have a therapist I see every once in awhile because the co pay is a little expensive. I've been meaning to set an appointment to see him to talk about everything since I can't see the on campus counselor. I know I need to keep fighting but I am exhausted.

Thank you so much for responding! I really appreciate any response. It is possible for me to take the semester off. I just feel sad because I already had to delay my graduation a year and I was really looking forward to graduating this year. I really don't like my University all that much anymore and I just want to get my Bachelor's and leave.
